validation.scope: Mapping is operation-level observation, never whole live-model parity; final maintained checks reported at delivery.

languageSecurityMappings.bytes: Uint8Array or explicit scoped byte source; admission always async; paths require supplied VFS authority.
languageSecurityMappings.mediaType: Explicit validated MIME and kind; no native codec runtime, transcoding, network, or playback.
languageSecurityMappings.poster: Both audio and video require explicitly supplied poster in this task under user instruction; original icon model/default remains unimplemented.
languageSecurityMappings.identity: SHA-256 integrity; SHA-1 only compatibility metadata; shared occurrence and resource identity are distinct.
languageSecurityMappings.timing: trimStart and trimEnd are milliseconds removed from beginning/end, not endpoints. Preserve unrelated qualified XML; absence/false/zero remain distinct; no duration lookup or playback.
languageSecurityMappings.model: Neutral snake_case live model names remain registered; detached editing operations do not implement Movie, Video, MediaPart or _MediaFormat interfaces.
